content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Amritsar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Amritsar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the ECHS Amritsar Recruitment 2026 is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ECHS Amritsar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the ECHS Amritsar Recruitment 2026. These vacancies are for the posts of Medical Specialist, Dental Asst/Tech/Hyg, and Clerk/Data Entry Operator.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for ECHS Amritsar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for ECHS Amritsar Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applying to ECHS Amritsar posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts in the ECHS Amritsar Recruitment 2026 is 68 years. However, specific age limits may apply to individual posts as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Clerk/Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Clerk/Data Entry Operator post in ECHS Amritsar Recruitment 2026 is Rs. 29,200/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ECHS Amritsar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ECHS Amritsar Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What are the required qualifications for the Medical Specialist post?
faq.answer: The required qualification for the Medical Specialist post is an MD/MS in Medicines. Candidates should not be above 68 years of age for this position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ECHS Amritsar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for ECHS Amritsar Recruitment 2026 primarily involves an Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form for ECHS Amritsar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application form for ECHS Amritsar Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the official website of ECHS, which is www.echs.gov.in.
